title: Northgate Tire Center Road Hazard Term Schedule — Share by Months Remaining
content:
# Road hazard credit share by months of term remaining

**Schedule.** The Northgate Tire Center road hazard credit carries a term share read from the months of the package's road hazard term still to run: the road hazard term less the whole calendar months from the installation date to the service date of the replacement entry (the most recent road hazard replacement entry recorded on the package). A month counts once its day of the month is reached.

| Months of the road hazard term still to run | Term share |
|---|---|
| fewer than 3 | 0.85 |
| at least 3 and fewer than 6 | 0.95 |
| 6 or more | 1 — the full share |

The road hazard term is 36 months on the Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard and the Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard, and 60 months on Northgate Premium Tire Care; the packages without road hazard protection show a term of 0.

**How the share acts.** The road hazard credit is multiplied by the term share. The share acts on the unrounded credit, and the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical: 36-month term, installation on 2023-05-20)

| Replacement entry dated | Whole months since installation | Months still to run | Term share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-11-20 | 30 | 6 | 1 |
| 2025-12-20 | 31 | 5 | 0.95 |
| 2026-03-19 | 33 | 3 | 0.95 |
| 2026-03-20 | 34 | 2 | 0.85 |

A credit of $120.00 before this share becomes $114.00 at 0.95 and $102.00 at 0.85.
